name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
name_kannada: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ (SC) ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India
short_description: Complete tuition fee waiver and monthly maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation courses.
detailed_description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their higher education, covering all non-refundable compulsory fees and monthly maintenance allowances.
description_kannada: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಎಸ್.ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್.ಸಿ ನಂತರದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.

rules.name: Social Category must be SC
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines 2020-21 to 2025-26, Section 3.1
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakh
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines, Section 4 (Means Test)
rules.description_kannada: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 2.50 ಲಕ್ಷ ಮೀರಬಾರದು
rules.clarification_question_en: Is your total family annual income below or up to Rs. 2,50,000?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 2,50,000 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದೆಯೇ?

rules.name: Must be an active student
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines, Section 3 (Eligibility)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently enrolled as a full-time or part-time student?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಅಥವಾ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ?

benefits_summary: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed + monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs. 1,200/month.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by authorized revenue authority (Tahsildar)
Income Certificate (valid within ceiling of Rs. 2.5 Lakh)
SSLC Marks card / Previous qualifying exam marks sheet
Aadhaar card linked with active bank account
application_process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or Karnataka SSP (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Complete student e-KYC using Aadhaar and mobile OTP.
Enter college admission details, college code, and course name.
Upload verified caste and income certificate RD numbers.
Submit and submit printout to the college nodal officer for verification.
source_title: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
source_excerpt: Scholarships are paid to students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum.
